competing_explanation: An apparent local oracle gain can be produced by incompatible PSNR aggregation, same-pixel action selection, global haze severity needing only one scalar correction, unstable or unresolved directions mislabeled as keep, action histograms without correct spatial placement, crop-boundary context loss, endpoint clipping, an unrelated-target selection artifact, input-identity drift, or pseudoreplication of cells and haze observations.
controls: the exact v2 typed closeout, summary, gate summary, 450-scene CSV, and S1 review closeout identities must match their frozen SHA-256 values
the archived CSV must contain exactly 150 unique original-clear scene identities per dataset with two nested observations and no replacement or backfill
historical v2 metrics, thresholds, gate outcomes, and terminal are immutable inputs rather than recomputed outputs
the v3 entrypoint and compact-analysis source identity must match exactly
the dense best single alpha selected with identical macroblock cross-fitting is an optimistic global-difficulty control and has strictly more scalar choices than the local oracle
the original shifted-target null estimate and interval remain unchanged; affirmative artifact and absence-certification precision are typed separately
a deterministic five-cell cyclic permutation of the selected local action map must lose at least 0.05 dB, testing whether utility is spatially located rather than caused only by the action histogram

two deterministic haze observations per original clear scene test direction and exact-alpha repeatability without increasing independent sample size; each observation-derived supported map is also transferred to the other observation and compared with that target observation's in-sample dense global oracle
weaken, keep_supported, strengthen, and unresolved labels use frozen positive evidence rules; unresolved never contributes to stability or keep prevalence
near-clear exposure, repeatable baseline damage, and damage-conditional mitigation are separate scene estimands; absence of material damage is safe_no_material_damage rather than unsafe
edge-versus-interior effects receive new grouped uncertainty while crop-side evidence remains explicitly missing
all bootstrap and Wilson uncertainty remains grouped at the original-clear-scene level and reports overall equal-dataset and dataset-specific support
no network inference or training, signal prediction, threshold search, mechanism selection, output image save, raw array read, or new per-scene GitHub evidence
disabled_actions: confirmation, sealed-final, canary, locked-test, NH-Haze, or non-development image access
network training, fitting, fine-tuning, observable-signal prediction, mechanism selection, or candidate promotion
using GT or GT-derived labels as inference-time input

changing either alpha grid, complete-image inference or scoring-crop rule, pairing ledger, cell grid, macroblock split, four-state label rule, direction or keep margin, effect margin, prevalence threshold, precision target, transfer rule, spatial permutation, or null control after outcomes
treating haze observations, cells, pixels, actions, or bootstrap draws as independent samples
interpreting the privileged residual-scaling oracle as a deployable post-processing method
saving or archiving images, arrays, checkpoints, feature maps, action maps, or per-cell tables to GitHub

claiming superiority to arbitrary global restoration operators outside the frozen residual-scaling interval and grid, complete source-provenance disjointness, observable predictability, module effectiveness, deployment readiness, or protected-set generalization
starting S2 or training any adaptive module without a later typed S1 PASS and a separate route-ready contract

gates.reference: S0, S1-v1 validity, and pairing-v2 typed authorizations; all compact parent files; the S0 role ledger; the pairing-v2 mapping ledger; six RESIDE roots; official model, checkpoint, runtime, and v2 entrypoint identities all match exactly

the SHA-bound archived scene CSV contains exactly 450 unique original-clear-scene rows, 150 per frozen development dataset, each with two nested observations, finite required compact fields, positive padded full-image area, and whole-image-inference-before-crop true; no roster scan, replacement, backfill, image read, or new inference is permitted

fail only when the unchanged archived un-clipped shifted-target null has simultaneous overall LCB at or above 0.05 dB or any dataset LCB at or above 0.10 dB, which is affirmative measurement-artifact evidence; otherwise pass, while inability to put every UCB below those margins is handled only by the inconclusive-only precision gate

favorable requires overall primary LCB above 0.10 dB, at least two dataset LCBs above zero and no dataset UCB below zero; aligned-versus-permuted spatial-specificity LCB above 0.05 dB with the same dataset support; equal-dataset material-scene prevalence LCB above 0.20 with at least two dataset LCBs above 0.10 and no dataset UCB below 0.05; and negative-tail prevalence overall UCB below 0.10 and every dataset UCB below 0.15. Any corresponding UCB impossibility is unfavorable; intervals crossing a boundary are indeterminate.

favorable requires cross-observation transferred local maps to beat each target's in-sample dense global oracle with overall LCB above zero and support in at least two datasets; direction-and-exact-strength stable-scene LCB above 0.50; bidirectional-scene LCB above 0.20; keep-supported-scene LCB above 0.20; and same-scene useful-bidirectional prevalence LCB above 0.15, each with predeclared two-dataset support and no-dataset-absence floors. Any corresponding UCB impossibility is unfavorable; intervals crossing a boundary are indeterminate.

after at least 42 near-clear-exposed scenes in at least two datasets, safe means either pooled and sufficiently exposed dataset-specific baseline-damage UCB below 0.10, or pooled and dataset-supported baseline-damage LCB above 0.10 with at least 42 damaged scenes and damage-conditional mitigation LCB above 0.50; unsafe requires material damage plus a conditional mitigation UCB at or below 0.50 in the pooled or sufficiently exposed dataset-specific analysis; all threshold-crossing or underpowered cases are indeterminate

met requires the archived primary overall and dataset maximum half-width to remain at or below 0.055 dB and all auxiliary precision components to be met: shifted-target-null overall UCB below 0.05 dB, every dataset UCB below 0.10 dB, valid edge/interior compact geometry, and an explicitly archived scoring-crop-side field; unmet or invalid auxiliary precision can only turn a provisional PASS into INCONCLUSIVE and cannot hide any decisive scientific FAIL

fixed_factors: the official ConvIR-B base architecture, checkpoint, candidate formula, alpha grids, scene roster, and v2 outputs remain frozen but are not loaded or recomputed
the v2 diagnostic candidate remains clip(hazy plus alpha times official-output-minus-hazy, 0, 1)
the local alpha grid is exactly 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25, and 1.5; the stronger global comparator uses 1001 values from 0.5 through 1.5 at step 0.001

every image is padded to a multiple of 32 and passed through the complete official ConvIR-B graph before one outcome-blind deterministic square scoring crop, whose side is the largest multiple of 32 not exceeding 512 or either image dimension and is at least 256, is extracted and shared by its two nested haze observations
four-by-four equal-area cells score the central 75 percent of each side, exactly 56.25 percent of cell area, without claiming or applying a taper

opposite 8-by-8 macroblock-checkerboard halves select and evaluate alpha in both directions; local ties within 0.005 dB prefer keep and then smaller alpha, while the dense global tie tolerance is 0.0001 dB

a non-keep cell is supported only when both halves select the same exact alpha and both opposite-half gains are at least 0.05 dB; keep_supported requires both halves to select 1.0 and every non-keep alternative to improve by no more than 0.02 dB on both halves; all other cells are unresolved

local and global evaluation-half SSE are pooled over identical scored pixels before one PSNR-ratio conversion; the two nested observation values are averaged and only the primary, transfer, and spatial-specificity scene values are clipped to minus 0.25 through plus 0.25 dB

Haze4K uses its fixed 150 development scenes under the original v1 salts; ITS and OTS use exactly the 150 plus 150 scenes and two nested observations per scene recorded in the SHA-bound pairing-v2 mapping ledger, with no directory scan, filename rematching, eligibility backfill, or variant reselection
the v2 closeout must bind the exact archived summary, gate summary, and scene CSV SHA-256 values, and the S1 review closeout must carry the exact contract-authoring authorization
the original clear scene is the only independent unit; haze observations, cells, pixels, actions, and resamples are nested
GT selects only this offline diagnostic oracle and is prohibited as an inference-time signal or proposed module input

the shifted-target null retains the original 0.05 dB overall and 0.10 dB dataset margins: an LCB at or above a margin is affirmative artifact evidence and a validity veto, while a UCB not below every margin is precision-unmet only

edge, interior, and paired edge-minus-interior 99 percent scene-bootstrap intervals are descriptive; the absent scoring-crop-side column is reported as missing rather than inferred from padded full-image area
confirmation, sealed-final, NH-Haze, canary, locked-test, raw images, arrays, weights, checkpoints, inference, and training remain absent
intervention.matched_budget: one compact pass over 450 archived original-clear scene rows, retaining 150 scenes per dataset and all v2 nested-observation semantics
intervention.primary_variable: predeclared reclassification of SHA-bound archived S1 scene evidence under distinct validity-veto and inconclusive-only precision rules
intervention.reference: the unchanged v2 privileged local-versus-dense-global contrast and its exact archived gate outcomes

primary_estimand.aggregation: equal-weight mean of the three dataset-specific means of scene-level two-observation local-versus-global PSNR ratios; within each observation, local-selected and dense-global-selected SSE are pooled over identical opposite-half pixels before one logarithm, then the observation values are averaged and clipped to [-0.25, 0.25] dB

question: Under a validity/precision distinction fixed before this reanalysis, do the SHA-bound development-only Haze4K, RESIDE ITS, and RESIDE OTS v2 scene results establish or reject same-scene, cross-observation repeatable spatial need for weaker, positively supported unchanged, and stronger residual restoration without repeating inference or changing any historical metric or threshold?
